name: Kubernetes service check
description: Verify required services, ready endpoints, expected External IPs and TCP connectivity

namespace.description: Kubernetes namespace containing the required services

services.description: Required service names, separated by commas or spaces
services.default: aerospike comm-sbi dns dns-http ebm-svc-udp gtp-http mm mm-controller-external mm-controller-internal netconf nm-loadbalancer-svc nm-postgres nm-postgres-config nm-postgres-repl redis redis-sentinel sctp-http sctp-sctp-field

external_ip_expectations.description: Expected External IP sets using service=ip[,ip];service=ip syntax

tcp_probe.description: Probe every TCP service port after checking service existence

probe_targets.description: TCP targets to probe: cluster, external or all
